news-global-econ.title: Raghuram Rajan urges Fed to raise rates, says rupee is not in panic zone
news-global-econ.description: Raghuram Rajan says the Fed should raise rates to contain inflation, while noting strong US investment, fiscal deficit and consumer spending are supporting growth.

news-global-econ.title: Nepal flash floods: Reconstruction costs could run into billions, says finance minister
news-global-econ.description: Nepal expects flash flood losses to reach billions of dollars as it seeks international funding to rebuild bridges, roads and settlements devastated by floods.

news-global-econ.title: 4,000% options surge in 15 minutes shows wild side of new CAS system
news-global-econ.description: During the first monthly expiry at BSE, a ₹64,000-put option tied to a bank index was trading at just ₹1.70 at the start of the auction. Within minutes, it shot up to ₹68.55, before crashing back to zero, all in just 15 minutes.

news-global-econ.description: A sudden 3% plunge in the BSE Sensex during a closing auction raises concerns over liquidity and potential market manipulation.
